abilities.description: Moves 2 squares toward an unmoved castling partner on the same rank; the partner jumps over it. Not out of, through or into check.
The piece the king castles with.
A 2-square straight move leaves an en-passant square behind.
Can capture a pawn that just made a double step, as if it had moved only one square.
Moving this piece resets the 50-move counter.
Reaching the last rank, it becomes one of the listed pieces.
Never moves; nothing passes over it. A piece standing on it loses the wall instead of being captured.
After capturing 2 pieces, this pawn can also capture straight forward and straight backward.
